profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I'm a software developer and engineer with a passion for learning. I seek constant exposure to new systems, ideas, and technology. I'm happiest when diving into something new and unexplored.  I'm already fortunate enough to have been afforded a breadth of experiences in my career, ranging across topics like datacenter sustainability, stereoscopic 3D, and neuromorphic computing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer on IDEAs Push team: One facet of Microsoft’s company-wide personalization and optimization platform, powering personalized communications internally and externally at scale. Designed and implemented features for, tested, and provided live support for messaging systems that power Microsoft's Azure email offerings.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · Azure Cosmos DB · Software Engineering · Git · YAML · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Consulting Computer Scientist
positions.description: Core developer on the Cognitive Computing Toolkit (CCT), a project born in HPE Labs. CCT is a platform for next-generation intelligent apps, with the goal of enabling users to express their machine learning algorithms at a high level while maintaining close to hand-tuned performance across a variety of accelerators, such as GPUs.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
2011: Researcher in non-volatile memory technologies and storage and memory subsystems.  I was particularly focused on phase change memory (PCM) and developed a tool to approximate the performance and power effects of adding various amounts of of PCM as cache and/or main memory to a computer system.

2012: Cog Ex Machina - a neuromorphic computing platform. 
My responsibilities include development of the debugging tools/framework, enhancing the user interface, and creating new ways to visualize our brain models and data collections.  As the project advances, so does the complexity of the data we're using.  Lately, I'm learning OpenGL to facilitate rendering of some of our more complex data types (e.g. multidimensional dyad fields) and for more performant integration with OpenCL, the language used to describe the bulk of our computations.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Researcher in datacenter sustainability and co-design.
I explored alternatives to heavyweight datacenter thermal simulations based on computation fluid dynamics, with the goal of building a tool that allowed for rapid exploration of many circuit board and datacenter layouts and that could be used by system architects in addition to HP's physicists and thermodynamics specialists.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed automation scripts, tested manageability firmware builds on enterprise-level server systems for the Manageability Firmware team

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Performed PCI card verification, tested system firmware builds on enterprise-level server systems for the System Firmware Team.
